products.title: Oteco Washpipe & Packing for Gardner-Denver Swivels
products.descriptionShort: Oteco replacement washpipe and washpipe packing for Gardner-Denver swivels, models SW-75, SW-125, SW-200, SW-300, SW-400 and SW-550 — 7 part numbers. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
Oteco replacement washpipe and washpipe packing for Gardner-Denver swivels. The size table lists every part with the Gardner-Denver swivel models Oteco lists it for: SW-75, SW-125, SW-200, SW-300, SW-400 and SW-550.

The washpipe is the hardened, ground tube that carries drilling fluid from the swivel gooseneck into the rotating stem, and the washpipe packing is the stack of rings that seals it. Both wear with every hour of circulation, so a swivel crew replaces packing routinely and washpipe at intervals. Oteco makes washpipe and packing sets for the main land-rig swivels, including split upper and lower packing rings with or without metal rings where the swivel needs them.

1 of the part numbers here name no swivel model in the source data; their make is inferred from Oteco's code numbering and the Fits column says so. We confirm the swivel model before shipping.

Pump and swivel makers' names are trademarks of their owners. Oteco parts are replacement parts made to fit that equipment; Indus Hydraulics is not affiliated with those makers.
